# Meow.Cro — detailed reference

> Meow.Cro is an independent crochet studio creating small-batch handmade accessories, floral pieces, plushies, and gifts.

## The studio

Meow.Cro is a small online storefront for handmade crochet creations. The collection includes accessories, keychains, floral bouquets, plushies, and home items. Pieces are made by hand in small batches; minor differences in color, shape, or stitch detail can occur.

## Shopping and custom requests

The [shop]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/shop.html) is the authoritative source for the current catalogue, product descriptions, and prices. Product availability and prices may change. Customers can send an idea through the [custom orders page]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/custom.html), but a request is not an accepted order until the studio confirms it.
